name: manual_087bbc
claim: Multi-repository remediation fixes must be batched locally and pushed exactly once per branch to avoid CI thrashing, review bot comment pollution, and intermediate broken states.

decisions.notes: Following the Orama micro-remediation doctrine across PRs #71, #17, and #432 prevented review bot noise and allowed all CI matrices to pass green on their first run.

rationale: Following the Orama micro-remediation doctrine across PRs #71, #17, and #432 prevented review bot noise and allowed all CI matrices to pass green on their first run.
